title: SAME ANSWER, DIFFERENT CLOUD SEMANTIC COURT
core_theorem: Same answer under a different lawful empirical predicate, risk set, response topology, joint configuration or provenance can be a different empirical fact and a different population response-configuration field. It becomes a different structural interpretation or mediation field only through separate explicit authority. It does not become an actor belief, psyche, identity or destiny from survey/population evidence.
jurisdictional_qualification: D09's SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED token protects a real semantic distinction from collapse while generic authority/consumer is missing; it does not pre-empt D12's classification of which empirical capabilities are terminally required.

binding_discovery_findings.D04: Current cloud has accepted metric/special-state/resume limitations and unresolved scalar/duplicate/multiselect/weight/routing semantics; its ordered-pair completeness depends on separately governed workload law.
binding_discovery_findings.D07: MATERIALIZE_ALL_PERMITTED is not established; future-authorized empirical queries must remain reconstructible; bounded V550J configurations have positive authority-selected workload scope.
binding_discovery_findings.D08: E1 conditional distributions, E2 multivariate joint incidence and E0B exact branch/cohort incidence fit a typed respondent-conditional algebra; equal numerical values under different predicates/risk sets remain different empirical facts; E3/E4 are derived/lossy lanes.
binding_discovery_findings.D10: No accepted current authority maps raw empirical coordinates directly into generated V3 structural-position bindings.
binding_discovery_findings.D11: Active non-joint spine is narrow answer/country distribution -> V551 -> V552; active joint spine is governed V550J pattern -> V551J -> V552J -> V553; generic cloud/branch conditional semantics are materially stranded or compatibility-only.

mandatory_human_cases.name: same answer / different cloud
mandatory_human_cases.result: Different E1/E2 empirical identity and population meaning field may remain despite identical focal marginal; no individual psychological difference follows.

mandatory_human_cases.name: same position / different answer
mandatory_human_cases.result: Exact generated structural position does not determine actor answer/belief; divergent V3 histories may lawfully produce opposite outcomes.

mandatory_human_cases.name: same cloud / different position
mandatory_human_cases.result: Same population meaning field can coexist with different generated positions; any differing applicability must use exact generated-position authority, not cloud inference.

mandatory_human_cases.name: contradictory / multimodal configuration
mandatory_human_cases.result: E2 or information-equivalent higher-order incidence is required when modal/pairwise summaries erase multiple substantial or contradictory configurations.

mandatory_human_cases.name: minority but real configuration
mandatory_human_cases.result: Low prevalence must not be converted into impossibility; supported minority configuration remains empirical fact, without implying actor membership.

mandatory_human_cases.name: cross-field disagreement / local-vs-global
mandatory_human_cases.result: Scoped local E1/E2 fields may differ even when a global average is stable; no single actor worldview may be inferred from the averaged field.
